epic.title: Epic session
epic.goal: Write the epic file: its intent, value, non-goals, acceptance, specs and stories in order, at concept altitude.
doNot: Name a mechanism or a file line in the epic.
epic.output: The epic file the shape check accepts, its review folded, and its queue row.
epic.done: The epic shape check accepts the file and the lens read is folded or carried to the maintainer.

design-consult.title: Design consult session
design-consult.goal: Settle one design question with the council and Fable before any plan is written.
doNot: Size the work by a prototype.
design-consult.output: The design record the epic's brief reads, each answer saved under the plans directory.
design-consult.done: Every member's fold is read back, and any fork left open is put to the maintainer.

spec-and-plan.title: Spec and plan session
spec-and-plan.goal: Write every contract the story creates or revises and the plan's ledger beside them, through one review of at most two rounds.
doNot: Write a test before the approval; a fold names its scenario instead.
Size a file in the plan.
spec-and-plan.output: The contracts as drafts or revisions and the plan, folded with the review.
spec-and-plan.done: The spec gate and the plan-shape gate accept, and the review is clean or its open findings are with the maintainer.

waiting-on-approval.title: Waiting on approval
waiting-on-approval.goal: Show the plan's essence and, on the maintainer's yes, record the approval.
doNot: Record an approval the maintainer has not given in the chat.
waiting-on-approval.output: The essence file and, on the yes, the plan's approval record.
waiting-on-approval.done: The record check exits 0 for the plan, or the maintainer has asked for a change.

tests.title: Tests session
tests.goal: Write only the plan's tests, each failing for the reason its scenario or acceptance bullet states.
doNot: Write a test that passes before its code exists.
tests.output: The plan's tests, staged, each red for its stated reason, and the session record.
tests.done: Every new test fails for its scenario's reason or on the absence of a name the plan adds.

code.title: Code session
code.goal: Write the plan's code until its tests and run-gates --pre-review pass.
doNot: Change a test except back to what its scenario states.
Write code no approved row or amendment entry covers.
code.output: The code rows written and every contract revision copied into the store.
code.done: The staged tests and run-gates --pre-review pass.

diff-review.title: Diff review session
diff-review.goal: Review the story's staged diff, run the final gates and the release where the story ships one, then commit and clean up.
doNot: Commit before the review is clean.
Fold a finding without asking the member who raised it.
Leave a committable output unstaged before the review.
diff-review.output: The reviewed commit, the release where one ships, and the plan's Phase: Cleanup done.
diff-review.done: The commit has landed and the Cleanup has run.

split-modules.title: Split modules session
split-modules.goal: Write the split's module list as a plan with no code.
doNot: Move a file before the approval.
split-modules.output: The module list plan and, on the yes, its approval record.
split-modules.done: The plan's record check exits 0, or the maintainer has asked for a change.

split-edits.title: Split edits session
split-edits.goal: Move the existing code and its cases into the modules the approved list names, then review, release and clean up.
doNot: Move a file the approved list does not name.
split-edits.output: The moved modules with their tests beside them, the reviewed commit and the Cleanup.
split-edits.done: The commit has landed and the Cleanup has run.

pause.title: Paused session
pause.goal: The session waits: the work stops here until the maintainer names the next stage.
doNot: Start a stage the maintainer has not named.
pause.done: The maintainer names the next stage.

empty-queue.title: Empty queue
empty-queue.goal: The session waits: no work is open until the maintainer opens some.
doNot: Open work the maintainer has not asked for.
